exposure: treatment with a cervical double balloon catheter
women with Type 1 cesarean scar pregnancies
cohort: 23 patients with Type 1 cesarean scar pregnancies (n=18) or cervical pregnancies (n=5) at an academic tertiary center
finding: Cervical double balloon catheter treatment was associated with no cases of maternal hemorrhage requiring transfusion, hysterectomy, or ICU admission.
